description.en: Planned animal asset: lateral gliding membranes supported by many long bony rods.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：许多长骨杆支撑的侧方滑翔膜。

scientific_scope.en: Living reconstruction proposal, not a scanned specimen. Named fossil reference supports identity and at least broad form; the low-poly instructions remain an original artistic proposal.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体复原方案，并非扫描标本。具名化石参考支持身份及至少基本体型；低多边形说明仍是原创美术方案。

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: lateral gliding membranes supported by many long bony rods. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 形态判据：许多长骨杆支撑的侧方滑翔膜。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block lateral gliding membranes supported by many long bony rods with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织许多长骨杆支撑的侧方滑翔膜；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval.

reference_notes.en: Taxon-specific URL verified; approval of all reconstructed anatomy is a separate gate.
reference_notes.zh: 已核实具名资料网址；全部复原解剖的批准仍是独立关卡。

sources.title: Gliding reptiles have been taking to the skies for 260 million years
sources.supports: Coelurosauravus gliding membrane supported by non-rib structures, grasped by forelimbs; Permian context.
